title: How to choose trail running shoes: A definitive guide
claims: 硬实土路或碎石路适合 2–4 mm 浅齿；泥地、湿草与软地适合 5 mm 以上、多方向深齿。
落差 8 mm 以上偏向后跟着地，减少跟腱与小腿负荷但可能增加膝负荷；0–4 mm 增加小腿与跟腱需求；4–8 mm 是多数人的起点。
防水鞋在冷湿或雪地有用，但透气性较差、干得慢；温暖天气网面更舒适。
防石板用于抵挡尖锐岩石与树根，平整路线并非必需。

verification.note: On 官网指南正文可读，含齿深、落差、防水与防石板 FAQ。

claimVerification.note: "hard-packed dirt or gravel … shallow lugs (2-4mm)"；"wet grass, mud, and fells … deeper, multi-directional lugs (5mm+)"。
"High drop (8+ mm)… reduces Achilles and calf strain, but potentially increases knee load"；"Low drop (0-4 mm)… more demand on the lower leg"；"moderate drop (4-8 mm)… starting point"。
FAQ："Waterproof shoes work well in cold, wet, or snowy conditions, but they're less breathable. In warm weather, mesh uppers… dry faster."
FAQ："A rock plate adds protection against sharp rocks and roots… isn't necessary for smoother terrain."
